title: Session list: add an "Error" status filter beside No filter / Working / Asking / Completed
outcome: Session list: add an "Error" status filter beside No filter / Working / Asking / Completed
acceptance: The session list's Status filter offers "Error" beside No filter, Working, Asking and Completed, with its own count. Selecting it shows exactly the visible sessions whose status is error; the other filters, their counts and the all-count behave as before.

When an error-state session already carries a provider or host error reason (for example a provider refusal message), the Error-filtered list shows that reason. No session lifecycle semantics or status values change.
Tests cover the Error predicate, the Error count and the rendered filter option; `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean and the affected vitest files pass.

completion.summary: Implemented Error status filter/count on docked and standalone session lists, preserving visible/project/search scoping and existing filters; Error rows retain existing error preview.
